parameters.name: num_products
parameters.description: Number of products in the planning problem

parameters.name: num_resources
parameters.description: Number of resources in the planning problem

parameters.name: resource_usage
parameters.description: Units of resource $r$ required to produce one unit of product $p$

parameters.name: selling_price
parameters.description: Unit selling price for each product

parameters.name: variable_cost
parameters.description: Unit variable production cost for each product

parameters.name: fixed_cost
parameters.description: Weekly fixed cost of activating the dedicated special equipment for each product

parameters.name: resource_capacity
parameters.description: Weekly available capacity for each resource

parameters.name: demand_cap
parameters.description: Optional maximum weekly sellable demand for each product

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Weekly production quantity for each product

variables.name: equipment_activation
variables.description: Binary indicator of whether the dedicated special equipment for each product is activated during the week

auxiliary_variables.name: production_upper_bound
auxiliary_variables.description: Finite product-specific upper bound on production used in the on/off activation linking constraint

constraints.name: production_only_if_equipment_activated
constraints.description: Production of each product is allowed only if its dedicated special equipment is activated; the product-specific big-M bound is used to link output to activation.

constraints.name: resource_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Weekly production must not exceed the available capacity of each resource.

constraints.name: optional_demand_cap
constraints.description: If a demand cap is provided for a product, production may not exceed that cap; otherwise the constraint is omitted in instances without demand data.

constraints.name: all_units_sold_within_week
constraints.description: All produced units are assumed to be sold within the week at the stated selling price; this is implicit in the profit objective and does not require a separate constraint.

constraints.name: nonnegative_production
constraints.description: Production quantities must be nonnegative for all products.

constraints.name: binary_equipment_activation
constraints.description: Equipment activation decisions must be binary for all products.

objectives.name: profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total weekly profit, defined as total sales revenue minus total variable production costs minus total fixed equipment costs.

final_objective.description: Maximize total weekly profit, defined as total sales revenue minus total variable production costs minus total fixed equipment costs.
